name: Bello
description: An adventurous raccoon bard from Bloomburrow whose elemental magic animates trinkets.

description_citations.text: "Bello". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bello travels beyond Bloomburrow, collecting souvenirs from other worlds, including a hedron from the Akoum Skyclave.
timeline.quote: His crowning achievement, he'll add with a grin, is a hedron plucked from the highest point of the Akoum Skyclave.
